to.description: Recipient(s) of the note. Either 'everyone' for all family members, or the exact first name(s) of one or several specific people whose profile you know (a 'Profile of <name>' memory entry) -- for several people, separate the first names with commas, e.g. 'Zara, Samira'. Use 'everyone' for time-critical information that concerns the whole family (e.g. an event today), not a list of everyone's names.

content.description: The message to relay to that person, phrased as Yasmin (first person). It is delivered with that person's next message, so write it as something to tell them at the next contact, e.g. 'I'm supposed to tell you to be home by 6 pm.' Maximum 500 characters.
